description: Our Power BI Image Grid visual displays your images as a visual grid, to present product catalogs, portfolios, or any illustrated content in a clear and interactive way. It is particularly suited for image-enriched data visualization across many domains, such as e-commerce, product management, human resources, and marketing. DISPLAY MODES Automatic: Responsive grid that adapts to the available width Fixed columns: Manually defined number of columns (1 to 12) Labels below: Text displayed beneath each image Overlay labels: Text displayed on top of the image with configurable alignment EXPECTED FIELDS Image URL: Field containing the URL of the image to display (required) Label (optional): Main title displayed below or on top of the image Text (optional): Secondary text or description Link URL (optional): Clickable link associated with the image Tooltips: Additional measures displayed on hover VISUAL CUSTOMIZATION Image size: Auto, Small, Medium, Large, or custom dimensions Customizable card and background colors Configurable corner radius and spacing between images Configurable shadows (blur, spread, offset, color) Label text color, font, and size Native Power BI tooltips or custom styled tooltips ANALYTICAL PURPOSE Browse and filter a product catalog or visual gallery Quickly identify elements through their visual representation Cross-filter images with other visuals for deeper…
